question: Why does Bhairava commend the goddess for asking about a matter rare even for the gods?
premises: Bhairava expresses strong approval of the question.
The subject asked about is difficult for the gods to obtain.
inference: Bhairava commends the goddess because her question concerns knowledge rare even among the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; I have been asked about something hard for even the gods to obtain.
